As a Thai citizen, you're normally visa-free in Vietnam for up to 30 days on a bilateral exemption — but since your trip is 31 days, that's 1 day over the limit, so the visa-free exemption doesn't cover you. You'll need an e-Visa instead.

E-Visa details:
- Valid for stays up to 90 days, so it comfortably covers your 31-day trip
- Cost: USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry)
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/, processing takes 2-3 business days (faster options available for a higher fee)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports (83 in this dataset)

One more requirement either way: your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

Data as of 2026-08-17 — verify current policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
